name: AnonX Music
description: A Telegram Music Player Bot, written in Python with Pyrogram and Py-Tgcalls.

MONGO_URL.description: Get a mongodb url from https://cloud.mongodb.com.

LOGGER_ID.description: Your log group ID, add your bot there and promote as an admin.

OWNER_ID.description: The user id of user whom you would like to add as OWNER.

SESSION.description: A Pyrogram v2 String Session from @StringFatherBot on Telegram.

USE_COOKIES.description: True = try cookies (yt-dlp) first for download, API as fallback. False = go straight to the API below. (Search never uses cookies/API — see core/youtube.py.)

API_URL.description: Base URL of your own download API, e.g. https://your-api.example.com (no trailing slash). Leave empty to rely on cookies/plain yt-dlp only.

API_KEY.description: API key for the download API above — ADD YOUR OWN.

WEBAPP_ENABLED.description: Run the mini listen-together room website alongside the bot.

PORT.description: Port the mini webapp listens on.

MINIAPP_LINK.description: Your bot's Telegram Mini App link, e.g. https://t.me/YourBot/room (set up with @BotFather first). Leave empty to skip the 'Open Room' button.
